title: Why Does a Fan Cool You?
hook: A fan does not make cold air from nowhere.
narration: A fan does not make cold air from nowhere.
It blows your warm air and sweat away.
Sweat drying steals heat from skin.
That is why a fan feels weak in very humid air.
